prompt: Popular events like the Football World Cup and other international sporting occasions are essential in easing international tension and releasing patriotic emotions in a safe way. To what extent you agree?
essay:
It is widely acknowledged that international games have considerable benefits not only for people but also for governments. While a significant number of people believe that these games place a burden on crime safety for home countries, I strongly believe that these events have a positive impact on relaxing global tension and bring people together for their countries' success because they can support their teams through games. This essay will elaborate on my position with relevant arguments and examples.

On the one hand, international games have a considerable impact on improving social cohesion for a country. This is because these events can bring people from diverse backgrounds to support their national team, allowing them to spend time together. For instance, while the USA has a society that is made up of people who come from different communities, World Cup games raise awareness of a sense of patriotism. As a result, these events strengthen bonds among citizens by building a common aim for everyone.

Furthermore, global events also have enormous economic benefits to contribute to governments' finances. These events, such as the World Cup, draw football lovers' attention from across the world, encouraging them to travel to the home country. When they visit a home country that changes every four years, they spend money to accommodate and taste new food. To illustrate, the 2026 World Cup is held in Canada, allowing the government to increase its income during the games through tourism. Thus, while there are concerns about safety from crime due to an excessive number of visitors who come from different countries, football games boost the economy in the short term.

In conclusion, although global games have drawbacks in terms of public safety, I firmly believe that they can create beneficial opportunities for people and governments because international events play a crucial role not only in boosting the economy but also in improving social bonds among citizens.
